entries.title: 掃堂腿與騰空閃避（雙人配合招式）
entries.description: 把一個雙人配合招式寫完整：紅衣蹲低轉身掃堂、揚起塵土；白衣同時騰空扭身躍過；鏡頭先低位推軌跟掃腿，再上搖跟躍起。『In perfect timing』寫出兩人的時間關係，很適合寫對打。
entries.prompt: The red warrior drops low into a crouch, spinning gracefully into a wide leg sweep. Dust lifts as his leg cuts across the ground in a powerful arc. In perfect timing, the man in white leaps high, body twisting as he clears the sweep with a sharp airborne motion. The camera tracks the sweep in a low dolly shot before tilting up to follow the leap. Wide framing shows the full choreography against the looming stone guardian, emphasizing the precision and control of both fighters. Fluid, elegant, martial artistry.

entries.title: 道場雙忍者紅藍氣流對練
entries.description: 偏『美術說明書』的寫法：大量描述道場陳設、色調、紅藍能量軌跡，動作只寫『流暢的武術動作』。效果偏表演而非實打，適合神明附身、法術對練這類畫面。
entries.prompt:
Create an 8-second animated sequence featuring 2 mysterious Shinobi ninjas sparing using ninjatō swords in a traditional Shinobi dojo. The dojo should have a minimalist design with wooden floors, tatami mats, and wooden walls, maintaining an open structure to allow for extensive movement and sparring activities. The ninja characters are dressed in traditional attire with a hood.

One ninja should be surrounded by swirling red energy trails that emanate from his body as he performs fluid, martial arts movements. The energy effects should pulse and flow, emphasizing their power and agility.

The second ninja should be surrounded by swirling blue energy trails that emanate from his body as he performs fluid, martial arts movements. The energy effects should pulse and flow, emphasizing their power and agility.

In the background, include traditional training weapons such as shuriken, kunai, and possibly a kyoketsu-shoge, mounted on the walls or placed around the dojo. Add scrolls and a few calligraphy banners with Japanese characters, reflecting themes of stealth, endurance, and martial prowess, hanging on the wooden walls. The overall color palette should be dominated by natural wood tones, with the glowing red energy providing a stark contrast. Subtle smoke effects at the base of the dojo can enhance the mystical atmosphere, while the open design of the dojo ensures the focus remains on the ninja's dynamic movements and the glowing energy trails.
entries.format: 原帖影片約 8 秒；畫幅 16:9
entries.author: Promethean

Their expression is razor-focused, eyes locked, muscles coiled with explosive energy. The opponent, a disciplined Kung Fu master with weathered features and sweat-drenched robes, leans back in surprise, caught off guard. High contrast, dynamic motion blur, traditional Chinese setting, dramatic lighting, cinematic action shot.

entries.prompt: A vertical American comic book page in the style of Simon Bisley, mixing divine iconography with brutal violence and anatomical exaggeration. A battle-scarred archangel in cracked golden armor plummets from the sky with a flaming spear, wings tattered and bleeding. Below, horned titans rise from storm clouds. One panel shows the angel roaring as he impales a beast through the mouth. Palette of radiant gold, ash white, and blood red. Glorious, apocalyptic, and sacredly violent. Dialogue and narration in illuminated manuscript-inspired English comic fonts. No real-world likenesses. --ar 9:19 --motion high --raw --video 1
